formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 x2 : ℕ) (x3 : Fin x1 → Fin x2 → Prop) [x4 : DecidableRel x3] (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   let x6 : ℕ := x1 + x2;   (∀ (x7 x8 : Fin x1) (x9 x10 : Fin x2), x7 ≠ x8 → x9 ≠ x10 → ¬(x3 x7 x9 ∧ x3 x7 x10 ∧ x3 x8 x9 ∧ x3 x8 x10)) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 x6 x5 → (∀ (x9 : Fin x6 → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x6 x5 x9 = Decidable.decide (∃ (x10 : Fin x1) (x11 : Fin x2), x3 x10 x11 ∧ x9 (Fin.castAdd x2 x10) = Bool.true ∧ x9 (Fin.natAdd x1 x11) = Bool.true)) → ∃ (x10 : List (ℕ × List ℕ)), (∀ x11 ∈ x10, x11.2 ≠ [] ∧ ((x11.1 < x1 ∧ ∀ x13 ∈ x11.2, x1 ≤ x13 ∧ x13 < x6) ∨ x1 ≤ x11.1 ∧ x11.1 < x6 ∧ ∀ x13 ∈ x11.2, x13 < x1)) ∧ (∀ (x11 : Fin x1) (x12 : Fin x2), x3 x11 x12 ↔ ∃ x13 ∈ x10, x13.1 = ↑x11 ∧ x1 + ↑x12 ∈ x13.2 ∨ x13.1 = x1 + ↑x12 ∧ ↑x11 ∈ x13.2) ∧ (List.map (fun (x11 : ℕ × List ℕ) => x11.2.length) x10).sum + x10.length - (1 : ℕ) ≤ x5.size)
